name: update_trigger
description: Update an existing trigger. Pass only the fields you want to change; omitted fields are left alone. `trigger_nl_condition` is the **if** condition; `actions` REPLACES the whole delivery list when passed (each entry: a message, plus an optional `destination_config_id` from `get_destination_configs`). Use `enabled` to disable/re-enable a trigger without deleting it. Only call if the user is specifically asking for a trigger update.

trigger_id.description: ID of the trigger to update (e.g. `trg_abc123...`).

scope_path.description: New scope (wiki-relative file or directory; use `/` or an empty string for the whole wiki). Omit to keep current.

trigger_nl_condition.description: New **if condition**. Omit to keep current.

actions.description: New delivery list — replaces ALL current actions. Each entry: `message` (required) and optional `destination_config_id`. Omit to keep current.

enabled.description: Disable or re-enable the trigger. Omit to keep current.
